options.name: manager
options.description: The package manager(s) used by the system so we can query the package information. This is a list and can support multiple package managers per system, since version 2.8. The V(portage) and V(pkg) options were added in version 2.8. The V(apk) option was added in version 2.11. The V(pkg_info)' option was added in version 2.13. Aliases were added in 2.18, to support using C(manager={{ansible_facts['pkg_mgr']}})

options.name: strategy
options.description: This option controls how the module queries the package managers on the system.
